dogSheet:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production character model sheet for the game BitDog: Zoomies.
Reference image 1 is the ACTUAL BitDog website mascot. Use ONLY the golden retriever at the top of this image as the identity reference. Ignore all website text, reward tables, numbers and marketing graphics.
Create one beautiful high-resolution landscape animation CHARACTER SHEET on warm off-white paper, labeled BITDOG / CHARACTER MODEL 01.
Translate that exact friendly golden retriever into polished 2D hand-drawn animation design: honey-gold medium-length feathered fur, darker floppy ears, cream muzzle and fluffy cream chest, big kind dark-brown eyes, black nose, happy pink tongue, slightly rounded youthful face, natural four-legged retriever anatomy, bushy tail. CRITICAL identity feature: ORANGE triangular neck bandana with a crisp WHITE Bitcoin B symbol centered on the front. No green collar. Dog remains a golden retriever, not a dachshund or human mascot.
Upper row: consistent full-body FRONT, THREE-QUARTER, SIDE, BACK turnaround views at identical scale.
Lower row: expressive close-ups ATTENTIVE / LOOKING UP, HAPPY / TONGUE OUT, DETERMINED / FETCH; plus two dynamic full-body galloping and coiled rolling action studies.
Clean studio animation linework, soft cel shading, subtly textured fur tufts, warm cheerful cinematic style compatible with anime action, anatomically consistent legs and ears. Nicely spaced usable production drawing sheet, small understated labels and palette swatches, generous margins. No environment, no owner, no numerical claims, no financial information. Preserve mascot identity and orange bandana consistently across EVERY view.
dogRevision:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached BitDog character model sheet.
Change ONLY the orange tennis ball in the mouth of the lower-row DETERMINED / FETCH head study into a thick round GOLD BITCOIN COIN with a readable embossed Bitcoin B symbol. The dog should grip the coin gently by its lower rim, with the coin face visible.
Keep absolutely everything else unchanged: all dog drawings, facial identity, golden fur, orange bandana and its white Bitcoin symbol, poses, page layout, text, color swatches, linework, paper background and image dimensions. Do not add or remove any other elements. This is a dog who fetches bitcoins, not tennis balls.
ownerSheet:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production character sheet for THE OWNER in BitDog: Zoomies.
Reference image 1 is the finished BitDog model sheet. Match its polished warm 2D animation linework, soft cel shading and production-sheet presentation. BitDog is always the hero; the owner is a quiet supporting presence.
Create a high-resolution landscape character model sheet on warm off-white paper titled "THE OWNER / CHARACTER MODEL 02".
Subject: an ordinary adult male dog owner, relaxed proportions, muted sage-green overshirt with sleeves rolled to forearms, plain oatmeal T-shirt, dark slate casual trousers, off-white sneakers with gum soles, lightly tanned hands. No hats, no jewelry, no logos. Clothing is deliberately low contrast to keep the golden retriever and orange bandana visually dominant.
CRITICAL: NEVER SHOW THE OWNER'S FACE in ANY drawing. Not eyes, nose, mouth, facial profile, or facial features. He is not a blank faceless mannequin: deliberately frame him naturally from the neck down for front views, or show only the BACK of his head and shoulders for rear views. His rear head has simple short dark brown hair. Every glimpse of the head must be unambiguously from behind, with no visible cheek or profile.
Upper row: FRONT / NECK-DOWN, BACK view, REAR THREE-QUARTER view. All full outfit studies consistent in design and proportions; front study crops just above collar.
Lower strip of four cinematic action poses, waist-up from BEHIND with no face, showing 1) hand cradling a large gold Bitcoin coin near chest, head bowed toward it, 2) rear head tilting down toward the dog out of frame, 3) right arm drawn back preparing the throw, 4) right arm following through toward the distance.
Include two hand close-ups showing the same thick round gold Bitcoin coin with embossed Bitcoin B symbol: holding it flat and releasing it. Coin roughly palm-sized. No actual money claims.
A small reference-scale silhouette of the reference golden retriever may appear at the bottom beside the legs for dog-eye camera height; preserve orange Bitcoin bandana if dog is shown. Small understated notes: "FACE NEVER SHOWN", "DOG-EYE CAMERA", "MUTED SUPPORTING PALETTE".
Clear well-spaced production layout, consistent costume in all poses. Owner never becomes a heroic portrait. No scenery.
spriteAtlas:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent game animation sprite atlas, matching the attached finalized BitDog character sheet.
Create ONE landscape 2048x1024 PNG with GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. EXACT layout: 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows, 8 cells, each cell 512x512. No labels, no grid lines, no text outside the dog's white Bitcoin symbol, no shadows, no ground, no scenery, no motion lines. Entire canvas background genuinely transparent.
Every cell contains ONE isolated full-body version of the SAME honey-gold fluffy golden retriever from the reference, same face, ears, eyes, cream muzzle and chest, orange triangular bandana with WHITE Bitcoin symbol. Clean detailed 2D animation cel style matching the reference. Consistent scale: entire dog's nose-to-tail width around 440 pixels for running poses, feet baseline around y=440 within each cell. Keep all fur and tail within each cell with at least 24px transparent margin.
Cell order LEFT TO RIGHT top row then bottom row:
0: sitting, rear body three-quarter, friendly face lifted toward upper LEFT at owner, alert floppy ears, tail resting to right.
1: same sitting pose and position, head looking high toward upper RIGHT following a thrown coin, ears raised slightly.
2: right-facing side-view running cycle A, full extended gallop, forelegs reaching forward, hindlegs backward, airborne.
3: right-facing side-view running cycle B, front paws touching ground, rear legs folding forward underneath body.
4: right-facing side-view running cycle C, tucked airborne phase, four paws gathering under belly, back arched slightly.
5: right-facing side-view running cycle D, hind paws pushing off ground, forelegs folding and beginning to reach.
6: right-facing neutral standing profile, four paws on baseline, happy face with tongue out.
7: curled-up fluffy golden tumble-ball, orange bandana visible, four paws tucked inward, head identifiable, compact circular silhouette.
Character identity must remain constant; only pose changes. Bandana remains ORANGE, NEVER green collar. Four legs only. No Bitcoin in mouth for these frames. No extra props. Professional transparent animation atlas, not a labeled character sheet.
